text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I'm certain someone called out to me 
from over here...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Is this a prank? How troublesome. Time is 
a finite resource, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If this continues to waste our time, then 
we will have to—...
